name: Notion
description: Notion in the Workspace, both ways and close to live: the pages, databases and rows you share with your integration come in under My Notion; what you change on either side reaches the other within seconds. Use Zeff in place of Notion, or beside it.
author: Zeff

settings.label: Notion token
settings.help: Your integration's secret: in Notion, Settings → Connections → Develop or manage integrations → New integration (internal) → copy the secret. Then share the pages you want in Zeff with it (a page's ••• → Connections).

settings.label: New pages from Zeff go to
settings.help: Optional: a Notion page's link — pages you make right under My Notion in Zeff are made there (shared with the integration). Pages you make below synced pages go next to them in Notion anyway.
